scripts.start:backend: npm --workspace=backend run build && npm --workspace=backend run start
scripts.start:frontend: npm run build:frontend && npm --workspace=frontend run preview -- --host
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm --workspace=backend run test && npm --workspace=frontend run test
